wish: someone should make a tool that generates QR codes without a web service
spec:
Turns text, a link or Wi-Fi details into a QR code right in the browser, with a selectable error-correction level.
Type or paste, or switch to Wi-Fi and enter the network name and password; the code updates as you type; download it as PNG or SVG.
It sends nothing anywhere, does not scan codes, and does not remember what you encoded.
notes: QR encoder written from scratch (byte mode, UTF-8, versions 1-40, L/M/Q/H, all 8 masks). Matrices cross-checked bit-for-bit against the python qrcode library on 88 cases up to version 40.
